adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the original token refresh call with refreshOAuthTokens(). The original code called `hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken()` which returns a HubspotToken directly. Now with refreshOAuthTokens(), when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, it returns a fetch Response object instead (line 7-14 in refreshOAuthTokens.ts shows it returns the raw fetch response). The code then assigns this Response to `hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken` and uses it as if it were a token object. This is a type mismatch - a Response object doesn't have token fields like access_token, so subsequent code using hubspotRefreshToken would fail.
